 Movies Published November 11, 2026 Countdown to ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ with Marvel Movies and Shows on Disney+ 
 Check out the official watch guide, featuring movies and shows from across Marvel’s cinematic history! 
 BY William Shammah The countdown to Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Doomsday is on.
 Itching for an MCU rewatch or tuning in for the very first time? Return to the Marvel Cinematic Universe with the genre-spanning Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Collection on Disney+. Through a curated selection of films and TV series, meet the characters of Doomsday and dive into the Multiverse and its many realities. And just in time for the theatrical release of Avengers: Doomsday on December 18, stream Avengers Endgame: Encore beginnning November 13, only on Disney+.
 From the very first-live action X-Men  films of the 2000s to Marvel Studios’ ambitious expansion into television with beloved shows like Loki ,  the official watch guide celebrates the legacy of Marvel’s decade-spanning cinematic history.   Get comfortable, grab your remote, and fire up Disney+ – the Multiverse is only a click away.
 X-Men 
 The X-Men , a group of mutants with extraordinary powers, wage a fight against both intolerance, and a fellow band of radical mutants intent on exterminating the human race.
 X2: X-Men United 
 After a military assault on Xavier 's school leaves the Professor and several students in enemy hands, the X-Men must team up with their greatest enemy, Magneto , to prevent the total eradication of mutants.
 Marvel Studios’ Captain America: The First Avenger 
 After being deemed unfit for military service, Steve Rogers  volunteers for a top-secret research project that transforms him into the super soldier Captain America. Armed with unmatched strength and his legendary shield, he leads the charge against Hydra , a rogue weapons division spearheaded by the ruthless Red Skull .
 Marvel’s The Avengers 
 Nick Fury , director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D. , finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. The Avengers – Iron Man , the Hulk , Thor , and Captain America – assemble alongside Black Widow and Hawkeye to battle an unexpected enemy: the Asgardian god Loki , who commands a powerful Chitauri army threatening global safety and security.
 Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Infinity War 
 An unprecedented cinematic journey ten years in the making and spanning the entire Marvel Cinematic Universe, Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Infinity War brings to the screen the ultimate, deadliest showdown of all time. The Avengers and their Super Hero allies must be willing to sacrifice all in an attempt to defeat the powerful Thanos , before his blitz of devastation and ruin puts an end to the universe.
 Marvel Studios’ Avengers Endgame: Encore 
 The epic conclusion to the Infinity Saga that became a critically acclaimed worldwide phenomenon, this dramatic showdown pits the Avengers against the universe’s most powerful villain, Thanos. After devastating events wiped out half the world’s population and devastated their ranks, the remaining heroes struggle to move forward. But they must come together to restore order and harmony in the universe and bring their loved ones back. 
 Marvel Studios’ Loki 
 Season 1 | Season 2
 After escaping with the Tesseract during the events of Avengers: Endgame , Loki, the mercurial God of Mischief is captured by the mysterious Time Variance Authority . Forced to help repair the timeline, Loki must embark on a reality-bending journey that threatens the fabric of the Multiverse and makes the ultimate choice to protect the people he loves.
 Marvel Studios’ Shang-Chi and The Legend of The Ten Rings 
 Shang-Chi must confront the hidden past he thought he left behind when he is drawn back into the web of the legendary  Ten Rings , and forced to stand against his formidable father, the organization's ancient leader.
 Marvel Studios’ Spider‑Man: No Way Home   
 For the first time in the cinematic history of Spider-Man , our friendly neighborhood hero's identity is revealed, bringing his Super Hero responsibilities into conflict with his normal life and putting those he cares about most at risk. When he enlists Doctor Strange 's help to restore his secret, the spell tears a hole in their world, releasing the most powerful villains who've ever fought a Spider-Man in any universe. Now, Peter will have to overcome his greatest challenge yet, which will not only forever alter his own future, but the future of the Multiverse.
 Marvel Studios’ Black Panther: Wakanda Forever 
 Following the devastating loss of their king, Wakanda faces a world eager to exploit its resources, as well as a formidable new adversary from a hidden undersea kingdom. To save their nation,  Shuri , Queen Ramonda , and their allies must embrace a new destiny to defend their borders and protect their way of life.
 Marvel Studios’ Captain America: Brave New World 
 Now carrying the mantle of Captain America, Sam Wilson must navigate a lethal web of global espionage and political betrayal. To stop an impending international crisis, Sam must unravel a shadow-conspiracy before the entire world is pushed to the brink.
 Marvel Studios’ Deadpool & Wolverine 
 Marvel Studios presents their most significant mistake yet. With his mercenary days behind him, a listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life. But when his entire universe faces an existential threat, he suits up to convince a very grumpy Wolverine to help him.
 Marvel Studios’ Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness 
 In Marvel Studios’ Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness , the MCU unlocks the Multiverse and pushes its boundaries further than ever before. Journey into the unknown with Doctor Strange, who, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious adversary.
 Marvel Studios’ Thunderbolts* 
 After surviving a lethal setup, a chaotic crew of Marvel’s most cynical antiheroes is forced to reluctantly band together. Confronted by their dark pasts, this lovably dysfunctional team must figure out how to work together… before they end up killing each other.
 Marvel Studios’ The Fantastic Four: First Steps 
 Set against the vibrant backdrop of a 1960s-inspired, retro-futuristic world, Marvel Studios’ The Fantastic Four: First Steps introduces Marvel's First Family — Reed Richards/Mister Fantastic , Sue Storm/Invisible Woman , Johnny Storm/Human Torch , and Ben Grimm/The Thing — as they face a daunting challenge. Forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, they must defend Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic Herald, Silver Surfer . And if Galactus' plan to devour the entire planet and everyone on it weren't bad enough, it suddenly gets very personal.
 Check out the Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Collection on Disney+ and get tickets for Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday , only in theaters on December 18.
